description:
`[validation].strictness` is configurable but has no validation behavior. Resolve the false contract by removing/migrating the key or by defining and implementing its behavior; do not leave selectable ignored values.

Source: `.jit/config.toml:42-47`; `crates/jit/src/config.rs:284-305`; `docs/reference/configuration.md:75-91`; `dev/active/36d5451e-audit-notes.md:75-83,126-134`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One coherent outcome is selected: remove/migrate the key or give every documented value observable tested behavior.
- [hard] REQ-02: Templates, parsing, examples, and reference documentation agree with that outcome.
- [hard] REQ-03: Regression tests prove no accepted strictness setting is silently inert.
title: Resolve the inert validation strictness contract
